notes: Waivers are intended to be empty in the steady state. Any entry added here must reference a legal sign-off recorded in release tracking and a follow-up issue to remove the waiver.

Dev-only npm packages (lockfile `dev: true`) and platform-specific optional binaries (lockfile `optional: true`) are excluded from the verifier failure set in scripts/compliance/verify-commercial-compliance.js because they are never bundled into the shipped installer.
